app.name: signbyte
app.tagline: Sign, validate and preserve - the trusted European way.

shell.storageNote: Encrypted, ephemeral storage - documents auto-delete after 24 hours.

login.title: Sign in to {brand}
login.subtitle: Use your national eID. We never see a password or a signing key — you confirm in your own eID app or with your card.

methodDesc.eparakstsMobile: Approve in the eParaksts mobile app
methodDesc.webEid: Use your eID card in this browser
methodDesc.eidScan: Scan your eID card with your phone

login.loaNote: You'll be redirected to your eID provider at LoA High, then returned here.

returning.body: Confirm in {method} if prompted. We'll take you to your dashboard automatically.

login.failedBody: The request was cancelled or timed out in your eID app. No session was created.

callback.completingBody: This only takes a moment — we'll take you to your dashboard automatically.
callback.failed: We could not complete your sign-in.
callback.cancelled: Sign-in was cancelled. You can try again when you are ready.
callback.idpError: The identity provider had a problem. Please try again.

verify.heading: Verify a document
verify.sub: Check who signed a document and whether the signatures are valid. Works for signed PDF and ASiC-E (.asice, .edoc) files — no account needed.
verify.dropTitle: Drop a signed document here or click to browse
verify.dropHint: Signed PDF or ASiC-E container, up to 25 MB. The file is checked and immediately discarded — nothing is stored.

err.notSigned: This document carries no signature — there is nothing to verify.
err.unsupportedType: Only a signed PDF or ASiC-E container (.pdf, .asice, .edoc, .sce) can be verified.
err.malformed: This file can't be read as a signed document — it may be damaged or mislabeled.
err.tooLarge: This file is too large. The limit is 25 MB.
err.rateLimited: Too many verification requests — please wait a moment and try again.
err.upstream: The validation service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.

verify.checkingHint: Validated against the EU trust lists — usually a few seconds.

extMissing.title: Browser extension not found
extMissing.body: To sign with your eID card you need the national eID software and its browser extension installed and enabled.
extMissing.item3: A card reader with your eID card inserted

home.title: Home
home.empty: Nothing needs your attention right now.
home.recentEmpty: Your recent signing activity will appear here.

documents.title: Documents
documents.subtitle: Everything you've uploaded, signed or been invited to sign.

upload.ttlNote: Encrypted at rest. Documents auto-delete after 24 hours; co-signing rolls the time-to-live forward. You can delete a document manually at any time.

note.expired: Storage lapsed — the encrypted bytes were auto-deleted; the validation report is kept.

empty.title: No documents yet
empty.body: Start a signature to add your first document.

error.title: We could not load your documents.

signing.title: Sign document
signing.subtitle: Choose how to sign. The method must match how you signed in.
signing.noFlows: No signing method is available for your sign-in. Sign in again to sign documents.
signing.chooseSub: Every method is LoA High and produces a qualified signature.

methodDesc.webEid: Sign with the ID-card in your reader. You confirm with PIN 2.
methodDesc.eidScan: Scan your eID with the eID Scan app and confirm there.
methodDesc.eparakstsMobile: Approve the signature in the eParaksts Mobile app on your phone.
methodDesc.eparakstsMobileEseal: Apply your organisation e-seal via eParaksts Mobile.
methodDesc.csc: Authorise a remote signature with your cloud certificate.

means.body: You are applying a Qualified Electronic Signature at the Long-Term (LT) profile. Under eIDAS it carries the same legal effect as a handwritten signature across the EU. Only a document hash leaves your device where the method allows.

finalizing.caption: Qualified signature · forming
finalizing.title: Finalizing your signed document…
finalizing.body: Sealing the document with your qualified signature. Keep this window open.

validating.caption: Validating signature · EU DSS
validating.title: Validating your signature…
validating.body: Independently checking the seal against eIDAS rules via EU DSS. Keep this window open.

complete.pendingSub: Your qualified signature has been applied — the document is fully signed and safe to use. Validation is finishing in the background.

pendingBanner.title: Validation is still finishing
pendingBanner.body: Your signature is applied and the container is ready to use. The independent eIDAS validation didn't return in time — it will complete automatically and the report will be available shortly.

complete.pendingNote: Validation report available once validation completes

card.title: Insert your card & approve
card.body: Make sure your eID card is in the reader, then approve the request in your browser's security prompt. There is no code to type.

remote.title: Authorising your signature
remote.body: Confirm the request in your eID app or on the provider's page. This screen continues on its own when you're done.

confirm.title: Confirm in your app
confirm.body: Open {method} on your phone and check the control code matches.

confirm.help: Having trouble? Open the eID Scan app on your phone.

declined.title: Signing cancelled
declined.body: The request was cancelled or rejected. Nothing has been signed — your document is kept as a draft.

phase.reading-card: Reading your certificate from the card...
phase.awaitingCardHint: Your card app will ask you to approve the signature.
phase.redirecting: Redirecting you to authorize the signature...

done.title: Signed & sealed
done.subtitle: Your qualified signature has been applied and the container is ready.

error.binding: This method does not match how you signed in. Sign in again with the matching method to use it.
error.notEligible: It is not your turn to sign yet. An earlier signer needs to sign first — you can sign once it is your turn.
error.chainAdvanced: Another signer signed this document while you were signing. Review the updated document and sign again.
error.inProgress: Another party is signing this document right now. Please wait a moment and try again.
error.invalid: The signing request was incomplete. Please try again.
error.notFound: The signing job or document could not be found.
error.card: The card signing could not be completed. Please try again.
error.cardMissing: The Web eID extension or app was not found. Install it, connect your card reader, and try again.
error.noDigest: The service returned nothing to sign. Please try again.
error.timeout: Signing is taking longer than expected. Check your documents shortly.
error.generic: Signing could not be completed. Please try again.
error.cancelled: Signing was cancelled or could not be authorized. Please try again.

inProgressWait.waiting: Another party is signing this document — waiting for them to finish…
inProgressWait.ready: The other party signed first — you'll now sign the updated document.

result.title: Validation report

sub.failed: Invalid · at least one signature failed

result.revealNote: Shown on request — not stored or transmitted. Revealing it is a local view action only and is not recorded.

means.passed: This is a Qualified Electronic Signature. Under eIDAS it carries the same legal effect as a handwritten signature across the EU. It is at the Long-Term (LT) level, so it stays independently verifiable for the lifetime of the signing certificate; with qualified preservation it can remain verifiable for far longer.
means.failed: At least one signature is invalid. The document's integrity or the signing certificate could not be confirmed, so this file should not be relied upon as qualified evidence. Request a correctly signed copy from the sender.
means.indeterminate: Validity could not be fully determined — typically because revocation or trust-anchor data was unavailable at validation time. This is not a confirmation of validity. Try validating again later, or request a long-term (LTA) version of the document.

result.auditNote: Tamper-evident audit trail recorded · portable evidence package available

document.heading: Upload documents
document.sub: Add the files you want to sign. PDFs are signed with PAdES; other files are wrapped in an ASiC-E container with XAdES.
document.dropHint: PDF, DOCX or images · add several files to sign them together in one container

err.malformed: This file can't be accepted — it doesn't match its file type or is damaged. Check the file and try again.
err.tooLarge: This file is too large. The limit per file is 25 MB.
err.infected: This file was rejected by the malware scan.
err.cannotBundle: These files can't be combined into one container.
err.cannotBundleFile: {name} can't join this set — it was removed; your other files are still staged.

document.alreadySigned: This file already contains a signature — you can still add your own.
document.wrapSub: Sign this PDF as XAdES inside a container instead of a native PDF signature.
document.wrapNote: Off signs the PDF itself (PAdES); on wraps it in an ASiC-E container and signs that (XAdES).
document.ttlNote: Encrypted at rest · auto-deletes after its retention window.
document.wrapForcedNote: Multiple documents are always signed together in one ASiC-E container — a native PDF (PAdES) signature applies to a single PDF only.

review.heading: Review what you'll sign
review.sub: This is exactly what your signature will cover.
review.wysiwys: What you see is what you sign.

preview.unsupported: This file type can't be previewed here. Download it to read the full contents before signing.
preview.pageError: This page couldn't be loaded. Download the document to review it.
preview.downloadHint: Prefer to read it in full?

recipients.heading: Recipients & order
recipients.sub: Sign it yourself, or invite a co-signer to the same container.
recipients.label: Co-signer identity code
recipients.error: Enter the co-signer's identity code (e.g. PNOLV-XXXXXX-XXXXX) so the right person can sign.

orderHint.sequential: Signers sign one after another, in order.
orderHint.parallel: Signers can sign in any order.

recipients.tierNote: Your free tier includes one co-signer. More co-signers and roles are part of Premium & Business.
recipients.notifyNote: The co-signer signs in their own session — the envelope appears in their signing inbox once they sign in with the matching eID. Email invitations arrive when notifications are enabled.

send.heading: Review & send
send.sub: Check the details, then send the envelope for signing.
send.failed: The envelope could not be sent. Please try again.
send.bundleNote: {n} files, packaged into one ASiC-E container

selfOnly.note: You are the only signer — continue straight to signing.

concurrent.inProgress: Another signer is signing this document right now. If you both sign at the same time, you may be asked to review the updated document and sign again.

actions.notYourTurn: You can sign once the earlier signers have signed.

error.action: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.invalidDocument: This document can’t be archived — it isn’t a valid signed document.

hub.preSigned: This file already contains a signature — you can still add your own.
hub.ttlNote: Storage is ephemeral — sign or download before the timer runs out.
hub.deleteConfirm: Delete this document? This can't be undone.
hub.audit: Every access to this document is recorded
hub.archiveNeedsValidation: The archive timestamp unlocks once validation passes.
hub.downloadFrozen: Signing is in progress — the document becomes available for download once all parties have responded.
hub.expiredGone: Storage was destroyed when the retention timer ran out. The files are gone — the record remains, and it stays available in History.

validating.caption: Validating signature · EU DSS
validating.title: Validating the signature…
validating.body: Independently checking it against eIDAS rules via EU DSS — this can take a little while.

history.title: History
history.subtitle: Records stay for 90 days after storage is destroyed. The files are gone — the record remains.

empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.body: When a document's storage timer runs out, its record moves here for a while.

history.note: Nothing here can be downloaded, signed, or re-validated — storage was destroyed when the retention timer ran out. The platform's audit records are the durable evidence; a file you still hold can be checked on Verify. Records are removed automatically after 90 days.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.session: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.upstream: A service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you were looking for does not exist.

accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
accessibility.intro: signbyte is committed to meeting WCAG 2.1 level AA.
accessibility.conformance: This service is designed to be operable by keyboard, compatible with assistive technologies, and readable without relying on colour alone.
accessibility.feedback: If you encounter an accessibility barrier, please contact support so we can address it.

orderable.rowLabel: {name}, position {position} of {total}. Alt plus arrow keys to move.

hero.title: Sign, validate & preserve — the trusted European way.
hero.lead: Qualified signatures at {loa} in under a minute, on any device. Cover the whole trust lifecycle — sign, validate, preserve and deliver — never locked to one provider.

lifecycle.title: Not just signing. Every stage of trust, in one place.
lifecycle.lead: Most tools stop at the signature. We carry a document through its entire legal life — and let anyone independently verify the result.

sign.title: Sign
sign.body: QES & QESeal at the LT profile. PAdES, XAdES, ASiC-E. Single or multi-party.

validate.title: Validate
validate.body: LTA-level reports via EU DSS. Anyone can verify a document and read the result.

preserve.title: Preserve
preserve.body: Archive timestamps today; qualified long-term preservation with auto re-archiving

deliver.title: Deliver
deliver.body: Qualified registered delivery (QERDS) with proof of send and receipt.

inclusive.title: Frictionless & inclusive
inclusive.body: Sign in under a minute on any device. WCAG 2.1 AA, multilingual, assisted and low-bandwidth flows.

qualified.title: Qualified by default
qualified.body: Every signature is LoA-High, QES-grade at the LT profile — with its legal meaning shown in plain language.

agnostic.title: Provider- & method-agnostic
agnostic.body: Many eID methods, multiple QTSPs. Cross-border and EUDI-Wallet-ready — never a single point of failure.

private.title: Private by design
private.body: Hash-only where the method allows. Ephemeral storage, and your identity code is never exposed gratuitously.

transparent.title: Trust transparency
transparent.body: See exactly what you sign. Recipients understand what a signature means and whether it is valid.

platform.title: A platform, not a portal
platform.body: Embeddable, API-first and workflow-rich. Templates, roles and webhooks for organisations.

trust.title: Know exactly what you sign — and what it means.
trust.lead: Before you commit, preview the precise document. Afterwards, every signature comes with a plain-language explanation of its legal effect and how long it stays verifiable.
trust.surfaced: Signer, format, level, timestamps and revocation time — all surfaced.
trust.reveal: Identity code revealed only on explicit action — shown, never stored or transmitted.
trust.public: Public, shareable verification — no full account required.
trust.legalBody: This is a {qes}. Under eIDAS it has the same legal effect as a handwritten signature across the EU, and remains verifiable until {date}.

cta.title: The most trusted way to sign in Europe.
cta.lead: Sign your first document in under a minute — qualified, and yours to verify forever.

footer.blurb: European Trust Platform. Qualified electronic signing, validation, preservation and delivery — built on certified QTSP infrastructure.
